site.name: Alviso / North San Jose, CA (illustrative 150 MW)
site.label_key: method: climada = CLIMADA worker output; cited = public source / repo-cached public layer / public model API; assumed = our assumption or unverified placeholder

river_flood_depth_p50_baseline.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.river_flood (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
river_flood_depth_p50_baseline.note: 0.0 = no flooded cells within the search radius in the coarse 150 arcsec global dataset; it does not resolve Alviso levee/tidal exposure. CLIMADA worker output is a first-order screening number (percentile of hazard cells within a radius of the site, not a point value); aai_agg uses the repo default exposure value in _damage.py, so USD figures are NOT site-specific loss estimates and are omitted here.

river_flood_depth_p95_2050.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.river_flood (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
river_flood_depth_p95_2050.scenario: RCP6.0 (worker maps SSP2-4.5 to rcp60; CLIMADA has no rcp45)
river_flood_depth_p95_2050.note: Only one flooded cell near site so p50=p95. CLIMADA worker output is a first-order screening number (percentile of hazard cells within a radius of the site, not a point value); aai_agg uses the repo default exposure value in _damage.py, so USD figures are NOT site-specific loss estimates and are omitted here.

wildfire_fire_pixel_brightness_p95.unit: K (satellite fire-pixel brightness temp, not a probability)
wildfire_fire_pixel_brightness_p95.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.wildfire (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
wildfire_fire_pixel_brightness_p95.scenario: historical only (no projections in CLIMADA wildfire set)
wildfire_fire_pixel_brightness_p95.note: The 2050 run returns the identical baseline (worker flags no SSP projection exists). Regional fire activity within 0.5 deg, not on-site burn probability. CLIMADA worker output is a first-order screening number (percentile of hazard cells within a radius of the site, not a point value); aai_agg uses the repo default exposure value in _damage.py, so USD figures are NOT site-specific loss estimates and are omitted here.

coastal_surge_tc_p50_baseline.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.coastal_surge (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
coastal_surge_tc_p50_baseline.note: NOT DECISION-GRADE for Alviso: the worker is tropical-cyclone wind-to-surge (Xu 2010) and the Bay Area has essentially no TC surge; the hit is a far-field synthetic-track artefact. Real Alviso coastal flood drivers are tide + sea-level rise + levees; use the FEMA AE/BFE values below. The 2050 run returned empty (no TC centroids within 1 deg).

seasonal_heat_hw_index.source: SeaBridgeAI climada-stack climada_workers.seasonal_heat (CLIMADA data API, cached hazard sets), run via data/shared/climate/run_climada.py
seasonal_heat_hw_index.note: worker returned empty: Copernicus CDS download/processing failed in this environment, and the worker does not support future years. Heat days were computed from Open-Meteo instead (see indicators).

tropical_cyclone_crop_hail.note: Not run: no relevant TC or hail hazard at this site (cached hail set is GBR only).

fema_zone.source: FEMA NFHL via Esri Living Atlas 'USA Flood Hazard Areas' (https://services.arcgis.com/P3ePLMYs2RVChkJx/arcgis/rest/services/USA_Flood_Hazard_Reduced_Set_gdb/FeatureServer/0), point query 2026-11-08; repo data/l2/site_risk.json

base_flood_elevation.note: Vertical datum not recorded in the cached layer; NAVD88 is ASSUMED.

design_implication.value: Elevate critical equipment above BFE plus freeboard (freeboard amount not looked up)
design_implication.source: repo data/l2/site_risk.json lean_rule_hint (FLOOD_SFHA is a permit/cost condition, not auto-RED)

days_tmax_gt_35C_baseline.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax
days_tmax_gt_35C_baseline.note: Future window is 2036-2050 (API ends 2050); future forcing is SSP5-8.5 per Open-Meteo. Coarse 25-50 km grid, no bias or elevation correction: indicative, not site-grade. Per-model values (EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR): [3.5, 5.4, 10.9, 2.9]

days_tmax_gt_35C_2050.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax
days_tmax_gt_35C_2050.note: Future window is 2036-2050 (API ends 2050); future forcing is SSP5-8.5 per Open-Meteo. Coarse 25-50 km grid, no bias or elevation correction: indicative, not site-grade. Per-model values (EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR): [6.7, 11.4, 13.5, 5.4]

days_tmax_gt_35C_delta.source: Open-Meteo Climate API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api), CMIP6 HighResMIP models EC_Earth3P_HR, MRI_AGCM3_2_S, CMCC_CM2_VHR4, MPI_ESM1_2_XR; computed by data/shared/climate/heat_openmeteo.py; multi-model mean of raw (not bias-corrected) daily Tmax

cooling_load_implication.value: More hot days cut economizer hours and push chillers to peak, raising PUE and peak MW; magnitude not quantified (no site PUE data in repo).
cooling_load_implication.note: Overlaps the Aug-Sep afternoon curtailment cells used in data/l2/l3_inputs.json.

site_in_cpuc_hftd.source: repo data/l2/site_risk.json (CPUC HFTD v22_3 via PG&E GRIP layer 18)

nearest_hftd_km.note: Measured only within the cached GRIP bbox; Tier 2/3 areas outside the bbox are not counted.

psps_direct_exposure.value: low: site and nearby GRIP substations are not in HFTD Tier 2/3; upstream transmission lines could still be de-energised (not mapped)

psps_context.value: PG&E ran PSPS events in 2024 (Oct, Nov, Dec) and 2025 (Jan, Jun); the Nov 5-8 2024 event de-energised 21,357 customers in 17 counties. Santa Clara-only counts not retrieved.

n1_firm_headroom_transmission.note: Ratings are ASSUMED MVA by voltage class, not utility data.

distribution_cap_by_curtailment_pct.note: GRIP is not guaranteed; not a PG&E determination.

aqueduct_baseline_water_stress.note: Not retrievable in time: the WRI Atlas/data download was not reachable by API from this session and web search returned no site-level score. Value is an unverified placeholder; replace with an Atlas lookup at the site coordinates.
